name: posX
comment: anchor of the running move (root = anchor + rotated animation displacement)

name: facing
comment: 16-bit angle

name: playerIndex
comment: 0/1, VRAM/CLUT offsets

name: bankType
comment: motion bank type (character record +9)

name: charId
comment: selection index 0-22 (20 = True Ogre, 21+ Tekken Force enemies)

name: index
comment: fighter index 0/1 (2 = third fighter in mode 8)

name: rootDx
comment: root displacement from animation

name: heading
comment: body heading (16-bit angle); facing follows it

name: relAngle
comment: abs(headingDelta): 0 facing the opponent, 0x8000 back turned

name: facingQuadrant
comment: own heading vs opponent direction: 0 front, 1/3 sides, 2 back

name: oppQuadrant
comment: opponent heading vs direction to self: 0 facing me, 1/3 sides, 2 back turned

name: rootMove
comment: move row driving root motion

name: poseMove
comment: move row driving the pose

name: moveFrame
comment: frames since the move started (1 at start unless the frame counter is kept)

name: damage
comment: damage of the running move (0 = not an attack)

name: state
comment: move +0x04: bits 0-2 posture (crouch/stand/down), 3-4 guard, 11-15 class

name: attack
comment: move +0x08: bits 0-2 postures hit, 3-4 guards that block, high byte level id

name: guard
comment: state bits 3-4 while guarding is possible, else 0

name: attackHi
comment: attack >> 8: 1 low, 2 mid, 4 high, 6 unblockable/ground, 8 throw

name: stateClass
comment: state bits 11-15 (12 = jump)

name: holdFrames
comment: frames to hold the last pose frame (-1 none)

name: branchWindow
comment: remaining frames of the matched branch window

name: frameStep
comment: +1 forward, -1 playing backwards

name: slideState
comment: 1 armed, 2 sliding (transitions 0x10/0x12/0x13)

name: hitDone0
comment: this move already hit fighter 0

name: hitDone1
comment: this move already hit fighter 1

name: branchKind
comment: 1 reaction, 2 input branch, 3 look-ahead branch, 4 move end

name: ballistic
comment: 1 while following a launch trajectory

name: attackSegCount
comment: 1 or 2 joint pairs in the move attack descriptor, 0 without an active window

name: attackClass
comment: move +0x14 bits 14-15

name: trackMode
comment: 0..12, see transitions

name: sideFlag
comment: mirrors stick left/right

name: gotHit
comment: hit (or guarded) this frame

name: contact
comment: own attack made contact this move

name: inAir
comment: move air window [+0x19,+0x1A] or juggled (+0x94)

name: activeSegs
comment: attack segments live this frame (0 outside [+0x2D,+0x2E])

name: hitFreezeIn
comment: freeze frames received from the attacker move byte +0x2C

name: distAdj
comment: distance to opponent minus size adjustment

name: dist
comment: distance to opponent

name: dirX
comment: x offset to the opponent (PairwiseDistances; ×10 on the fallback path)

name: dirZ
comment: z offset to the opponent (0 on the fallback path)

name: hitSlots
comment: 2 x 0x2C hit records (fields from +0x1C)

name: moveSlot
comment: current move slot

name: moveRow
comment: current move row

name: reaction
comment: reaction record

name: attackSegs
comment: 4 x 24-byte segments

name: hurtZones
comment: 14 x 20-byte cylinders

name: bodyPoints
comment: 8 x 16-byte points

name: health
comment: 16.16 fixed

name: inDir
comment: one-hot direction 1 << (d + 4)

name: inPressed
comment: buttons pressed this frame

name: inHeld
comment: buttons held

name: inHistory
comment: pressed << 4 | direction

name: scaleBase
comment: model scale, 4096 = 100%

name: joints
comment: 24 x 0x44 joint blocks

name: rootX
comment: world root position

name: localMats
comment: 18 x 32-byte local joint matrices

name: headingDelta
comment: heading - targetDir

name: aimDir
comment: targetDir or targetDir+0x8000, whichever is nearer the heading (updated beyond 0x200 units)

name: oppToSelfDir
comment: direction from opponent to self

name: oppRelAngle
comment: abs(oppHeadingDelta)

name: oppIndex
comment: default opponent index

name: lastAttacker
comment: index of the fighter whose hit was applied

name: throwState
comment: 0 idle; >0 thrower step count; <0 throw victim

name: hitFreeze
comment: freeze frames left (pose does not advance)

name: reactChain
comment: counts consecutive reaction moves (0x400 flag chains)

name: guardedPrev
comment: copy of +0xCF at move start

name: inReaction
comment: copy of +0xD0 at move start

name: condFlagUsed
comment: set by branch conditions 0x3A-0x3C

name: airKind
comment: 0-5, row of 0x8001A630 (ground offset, air move slot)

name: juggleCount
comment: air hits taken during the current launch

name: airSpeed
comment: horizontal launch speed

name: curSlot
comment: move slot of the running move

name: curTransition
comment: transition code that started the running move

name: slideTargetX
comment: point reached in 16 frames when slideToPoint is 1 (no writer of slideToPoint=1 in the code)

name: oppStartX
comment: opponent root at move start

name: crouchMove
comment: move flag 0x2000

name: stepKind
comment: 1/2 from transitions 0x1A/0x1B

name: airPhase
comment: root follows animation: 0 xyz, 1 none (launched), 2 y only (slide)

name: applyEndTurn
comment: add move +0x12 to heading at next move start

name: isCpu
comment: fighter is driven by the CPU AI (InputSource)

name: humanGuard
comment: set for human fighters outside mode 5; moves with state bit 8 keep their guard only when set

name: guarded
comment: last applied hit was guarded

name: hitClean
comment: last applied hit connected

name: whiffed
comment: active window ended without contact

name: counterHit
comment: last applied hit was a counter hit

name: closeHit
comment: last applied hit used the close-range entry (+0x34)

name: moveChanged
comment: new move differs from the previous one

name: aboutToHit
comment: damage move within 3 frames of its first active frame

name: extraKind
comment: HitExtraDamage mode

name: lastDamage
comment: abs(damage) of the last applied hit

name: damageOverride
comment: used instead of move damage (reversals)

name: hitCooldown
comment: no hit tests while > 0

name: recoverMash
comment: decreased by button presses

name: attackAlert
comment: 9 frames after a move with flag 0x800 starts

name: powerTimer
comment: 120 after move flag 0x10000; disables guard, forces counter hits

name: stepCooldown
comment: blocks branch rows with flag 0x1C

name: placedX
comment: anchor saved by FUN_800431B4 when the fighter is placed for a round (ArenaBounds pull-back target)

name: atkDirX
comment: direction of first attack segment

name: hitDirX
comment: attacker atkDir copied on hit

name: tiltX
comment: root rotation x (root matrix uses -tiltX)

name: tiltZ
comment: root rotation z (root matrix uses -tiltZ)

name: rootMat
comment: root rotation (MATRIX rotation part) from tilt and facing

name: prevLocalMats
comment: 17 x 32-byte local matrices of the previous frame (slots 1-17)

name: blendDelta
comment: 17 x 32-byte rotation deltas (9 s16 each) for motion blending

name: blendMode
comment: 0 none, 1 decay from previous pose, 2 blend into pending branch, 3 blend into stance

name: blendModeB
comment: cleared together with the blend mode (FUN_8003C4AC)

name: lastPoseMove
comment: pose move of the previous displayed frame (blending)

name: lastPoseFrame
comment: pose frame of the previous displayed frame (blending)

name: blendWeight
comment: 4096 * counter / frames

name: costumeKey
comment: charId*4 + costume: index into g_charRecords

name: voiceSet
comment: character record +8: index into g_charVoices

name: bodyContact
comment: pushed apart by BodySeparate this frame (conditions 0x33/0x34); cleared by FUN_80043F40

name: bodyContactWith
comment: per other fighter index

name: noBodyPush
comment: set by ArenaBounds when crossing the Tekken Ball court; body separation skipped when both are set

name: tapLP
comment: LatchButtonTaps: LP newly pressed; all three cleared once no punch button is newly pressed (conditions 0x3A-0x3C)

name: tapBoth
comment: LP and RP held with one of them newly pressed

name: bodyPushX
comment: BodySeparate correction added to anchor and root

name: curOppIndex
comment: the opponent currently faced (FightFrame, FUN_8002BFCC); in mode 8 it follows target changes (side flag, Force AI)

name: roundWins
comment: rounds won in the match; +1 per round won, both on a draw (FUN_8003E7C4); compared with the rounds to win 0x800AE2C4; saved and restored around a fighter reload (FUN_8002A5D8/FUN_8002A634)

name: roundWon
comment: round result (FUN_8003E7C4): 1 won, −1 lost; a draw gives both −1, or 1 to a side that reaches the rounds to win

name: winPose
comment: win-pose variant, 1 + frame parity (FUN_8003EB60); after a time-out the loser's −1 (both 0 when tied, FUN_8003EBF4); the round end waits until a positive variant's move has played

name: eventFrame
comment: the pose frame when the frame events last ran (MoveEvents runs the events after it up to the pose frame; blend source frame = value − 1)

name: hitDone2
comment: this move already hit Tekken Force fighter 2 (HitTest, index - 2)

name: hitDone3
comment: the same for fighter 3; also set to 1 when a queued move starts

name: moveFlagBA
comment: cleared at move start and at reset

name: moveFlagBB
comment: cleared at reset

name: skipStepPhysics
comment: cleared at move start; FighterMovePhysics skips its step handling while set

name: attackPending
comment: 1 while the running move's damage is still to come or the opponent's power timer runs

name: resetFlagC0
comment: cleared at reset; no reader found

name: noLookAt
comment: disables the head look-at (and Gon's eyes); in mode 8 set for CPU and fixed-facing fighters

name: lastExtraDamage
comment: HitExtraDamage of the last HitApply

name: prevHurtZone
comment: copy of the first hurt-zone words from the previous CollisionShapesUpdate

name: prevRootX
comment: root of the previous frame (FighterVelocity)

name: carriedHealth
comment: health carried into the next round when 0x800AFF59 is set (FUN_8002BFCC)

name: healthLeft
comment: health in 1/4096 of the maximum at the round result (FUN_8003E6D0); cleared at reset

name: scriptInput
comment: scripted input word (input mode 2: demo, practice dummy)

name: cmdCount
comment: command-buffer entries (at most 9)

name: cmdRead
comment: command-buffer read count

name: cmdMergeTimer
comment: presses within 3 frames merge into the last entry

name: cmdBuffer
comment: entries 1-9: held << 4 | direction while a move with flag 0x2000 runs

name: inPressedHist
comment: raw pressed pad words of the last 60 frames (ring, index +0x40C)

name: pressCount
comment: presses of LP, RP, LK, RK within the 60-frame window

name: screenXCopy
comment: screen x stored by FighterDrawParts for bank-type 11 fighters

name: airFree
comment: airborne and not in a reaction (FighterMovePhysics)

name: setupFlag128B
comment: cleared by FighterSetupParts

name: ogreFreezeFlags
comment: set while in hit freeze against bank 14 (Ogre), else cleared (FighterMovePhysics)

name: composeFlags
comment: cleared by FighterComposeJoints each frame

name: aiSlot
comment: AI record slot, -1 without one (AiInitRound)

name: aiTarget
comment: index of the fighter the AI targets (AiInitRound)

name: keepLight
comment: set while the body burns: back colour black (FUN_8003A564), FUN_8003A3B8 skipped

name: attachLocal
comment: local joint rotation of the first attached part (parts 18+, FighterComposeJoints)
